title: Data layers
intro: Bring in routes, zones and points from GeoJSON files, URLs or WFS services. Everything lands on the same site as your model, scans and map.

anchor.map: Placed against the map / model location
anchor.none: Not anchored yet: the first georeferenced layer sets the site.

wfs.title: WFS service
wfs.hint: Only the area around the site is requested, up to 5,000 features. The server must allow cross-origin requests (CORS).

source.coordinates: The data carries a Z coordinate.

warn.far: This layer is {{km}} km from the site — check its coordinate system.

error.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
error.unknownCrs: The data declares a coordinate system this viewer does not know.
error.projectedWithoutCrs: The coordinates are in metres but no coordinate system is declared.
error.noAnchor: No site to place the layer on.
error.http: The server answered with an error.
error.network: Could not reach the server — it may be offline or block cross-origin requests (CORS).
error.notWfs: That address is not a WFS service.
error.wfsException: The WFS server rejected the request.
error.notJsonOutput: The server did not return GeoJSON (it may only offer GML).
error.cors: The source does not allow browsers to read it (no CORS). Configure a proxy below.
error.notGbfs: That is not a GBFS feed.
error.notGtfsRt: That is not a GTFS-Realtime feed (JSON).
error.noGeometryInTable: That table has no columns with a location (lon/lat, WKT or coordinates). Join it onto a layer instead.
error.noJoinBase: There is no geometry to join onto.
error.tmbKey: TMB needs your own keys: add them under Live sources → TMB keys.
error.quota: The provider’s free quota is used up for now. Try again later.

restore.failed: {{count}} saved layers could not be restored (offline, or the file was too large to keep).

search.title: Search the twin
search.placeholder: Station, asset code, line, file… e.g. code:BCN-SANTS
search.hint: Searches every layer, IFC and scan loaded ({{count}} items), including nested attributes. Use field:value to filter.

symbology.hint: Each value of the field gets its own colour and symbol. Untick a value to hide it.
symbology.modelFailed: That model could not be read (GLB only).

links.pickTarget: Now pick what {{label}} links to: click a search result.

presets.title: Public live sources
presets.hint: Ready to connect, each set to how often its provider actually updates.
presets.needsProxyHint: This provider sends no CORS header: a browser can only read it through a proxy (see Proxy below).

bicing.name: Bicing stations
bicing.hint: Bikes and free docks per station (GBFS) · every 30 s

fgc.name: FGC trains
fgc.hint: Live position, punctuality and occupancy · quota-limited (5,000/day)

rodalies.name: Rodalies trains (Renfe)
rodalies.hint: Live positions (GTFS-Realtime) · the source refreshes every 30 s

catastro.name: Cadastral parcels
catastro.hint: Catastro WFS (GML) · 250 m around the site · static

bcn-traffic.name: Barcelona traffic (live)
bcn-traffic.hint: State of 500+ street sections · every 5 min · both directions, animated flow

tmb-metro-lines.name: TMB · Metro lines
tmb-metro-lines.hint: Official colours · needs your TMB keys

tmb-metro-stations.name: TMB · Metro stations
tmb-metro-stations.hint: All stations, named · needs your TMB keys

tmb-bus-lines.name: TMB · Bus lines
tmb-bus-lines.hint: Every bus route in its colour · needs your TMB keys

tmb-bus-stops.name: TMB · Bus stops
tmb-bus-stops.hint: Select a stop to see the next buses live · needs your TMB keys

live.identityIndex: Features have no stable id: matched by position in the list.

proxy.title: Proxy for sources without CORS
proxy.hint: Some public feeds (Renfe) do not allow browsers to read them. A proxy you control relays them. Use {url} where the address goes.

groups.priorityHint: A feature takes the look of the FIRST group it matches — reorder with ▲▼.
groups.name: Group name

look.label: Label
look.offsetHint: Shift each line to the right of its direction, so two-way streets show both directions.

zoom.hint: Like a web map: the further the camera, the simpler each point is drawn — so thousands stay readable.
zoom.onlyPoints: Zoom levels apply to point features; this layer has none.

agg.onlyPoints: Aggregation summarises point features; this layer has none.
agg.hint: From far away, show the layer as density or as cells coloured by a value — e.g. charger occupancy — instead of thousands of pins.
agg.legend: Closer than {{d}} the individual features return.

legend.title: Legend
legend.openHint: Show what the colours and symbols of your data layers mean
legend.tip: Click a group to hide or show it · Alt/⌘-click: only that group
legend.exclude: Leave this layer out of the legend
legend.aggregateFar: From far away it turns into a summary.
legend.zoomInForDetail: Zoom in to see each feature.
legend.inCapturesHint: While open, the legend is also drawn into screenshots, clips and GIFs. Minimise it to leave it out.
legend.scaleHint: Show a scale bar (also in captures). Only drawn when the view looks down enough to be true.
legend.scaleNeedsTopDown: Tilt the view further down to show a true scale.
legend.northHint: Show true north of the site (also in captures)
legend.northNeedsSite: North needs a located site (a georeferenced model, scan or data layer).
legend.move: Move to another corner (also in captures)

history.pastHint: You are looking at recorded data, not the present.
history.recordHint: Keep this feed’s past on this device to rewind it later (only what changes is stored).
history.nothingYet: Nothing recorded yet — history builds up while the layer is live.

join.title: Join a live table
join.hint: Values from a table refreshed on a timer (CSV, “;”, “#” records…) are matched onto these features by a key — e.g. a traffic status feed onto street sections.
join.headerless: The table has no header row
join.done: Joined — the layer now refreshes live.

alerts.hint: Get notified when features meet a condition — at once or after it has held for some minutes. Alerting features pulse with a red ring.
alerts.notLive: Alerts are checked on every refresh: turn on live refresh for this layer.
alerts.name: Alert name

tmb.why: TMB data needs your own free keys (app_id and app_key). Create an app at
tmb.privacy: Kept in this browser only and sent only to api.tmb.cat. Each user uses their own free quota.
tmb.bad: TMB did not accept these keys. Check the app_id and app_key in your TMB app.
tmb.keysSaved: TMB keys saved in this browser
tmb.arrivalsNeedKeys: Add your TMB keys (Live sources) to see the next buses here.
